target: वह अपना काम बहुत ध्यान से करता है।
english: He does his work very carefully.
reason: Bookish/officialese – "अपनी ज़िम्मेदारियों को गंभीरता से निभाता है" is testimonial-letter register, not everyday speech. Replacement keeps अपना + habitual present.

target: वह हम सब में सबसे छोटा है।
english: He is the youngest of us all.
reason: Padded testimonial ("most experienced and wise among us"); double-adjective praise nobody says, and "हमारे बीच" is stilted for "among us". Replacement keeps सबसे + adjective.

target: इस कमीज़ की कीमत कम से कम पाँच सौ रुपये है।
english: This shirt costs at least five hundred rupees.
reason: Pointless trivia – the depth of a pond in feet is not something a learner will ever say. Replacement keeps की possessive + कम से कम with a shopping context.

target: छात्र परीक्षा की तैयारी कर रहा है।
english: The student is preparing for the exam.
reason: Inspirational-story trivia and uses the pejorative अंधा; also breaks the node's present-continuous pattern. Replacement keeps छात्र/परीक्षा vocab in रहा है.

target: रोहित फ़ोन पर बात कर रहा है।
english: Rohit is talking on the phone.
reason: Near-verbatim duplicate of hi-0860 ("छत पर पतंग उड़ा रहा/रहे") only 6 ranks earlier – teaches nothing new. Replacement keeps present continuous with more useful vocabulary.

target: माँ चाहती हैं कि तुम जल्दी घर आओ।
english: Mom wants you to come home early.
reason: Near-verbatim duplicate of hi-1010 ("X चाहता है कि हम <city> चलें") with only the name and city swapped. Replacement keeps चाहना + कि + subjunctive.
PSA-style motto, and "फ़र्स्ट एड का पता होना" is an unnatural collocation (would be फ़र्स्ट एड आनी चाहिए). Replacement keeps को + चाहिए obligation.

target: अभी मत जाओ, बाहर बारिश हो रही है।
english: Don't go now, it's raining outside.
reason: Proverb-like moralising ("use your head, don't rush") – reads as a textbook motto. Replacement keeps the मत negative imperative in a real situation.

english: Heat the oil in the pan.
reason: Niche vocabulary – ओखली (mortar) is rare for a learner at this rank. Replacement keeps में + imperative with everyday kitchen vocabulary.

target: छत टपकने लगी तो मिस्त्री को बुलाया।
english: The roof started leaking so we called a repairman.
reason: Niche vocabulary (खपरैल = roof tiles) plus an awkward causative बदलवाई. Replacement keeps टपकने लगी + तो + past clause with common words.

target: भाभी जी की चाय सबसे अच्छी होती है।
reason: Decorative ritual phrase ("I touch your feet") that a learner will not use and that does not teach the node's comparative/generic होता है pattern.
Vacuous – "the child's ears are small" is not something anyone says. Minimal change keeps के possessive + छोटे हैं but becomes a usable sentence.
